scope:
Prepare matched occupancy-flow noise and original real-image conditioning.

DINO features, projection and learned aggregation run on FP32 CPU. The saved
inputs isolate flow/sampler accuracy from upstream TT errors. No sampling or
reconstruction-quality validation is performed here.
conditioning_boundary: Real-image DINO features, original projection and learned aggregation on FP32 CPU. Both TT variants receive identical inputs; upstream TT errors excluded. Separate dedicated seed-123 noise generator. Original sampler/CFG parameters unchanged.
artifact_note: Large conditioning inputs stay outside Git and are regenerated from pinned sources. Sampler condition/noise identity is hashed and checked for every trajectory.
